name: json-codec
algorithm: Decode a 1 MB JSON document (tools/bench gen kind json, seed 2), an array of records, into each language's structs through its std's typed decoder, reps times, and sum the records (README.md).

skip.c: no std JSON: C has no standard JSON decoder; no library stands in
skip.rust: no std JSON: Rust std has none (serde_json is a crate); no crate stands in
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the decode has no arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own algorithm; the checksum (ids, name and tag lengths, tag counts, truncated scores, ok flags, records at every level) checks that every decoder read the same records
notes: Idiomatic standard library (plan/06-m6.md 4.1): Mk std.json.Parse into a Value, then the FromJson that gen json.Codec emits per record, pushed into a List, all in an arena Reset per rep; Go encoding/json Unmarshal into []R0; Zig std.json.parseFromSliceLeaky([]R0) with ignore_unknown_fields into an ArenaAllocator reset per rep. Four struct levels R0 to R3 in every language, since the records nest through next at most three deep. Bytes per second = 1000000 * reps / median.
